heroLead: The land around St. Vincent College near Latrobe has stayed remarkably rural for how close it sits to a well-known campus, and a lot of the farm families nearby still hold mineral rights that predate the college itself by generations.
intro: The community around St. Vincent College sits just outside Latrobe in Westmoreland County, in farmland that's remained largely intact even as the surrounding area has grown. Marcellus wet-gas activity has touched this part of the county over the years, and family farms near the college have, in some cases, ended up inside pooled drilling units drawing gas from beneath multiple adjoining properties.

Because a lot of these tracts have stayed in the same families for a long time, mineral records here tend to be relatively well documented, though not always up to date with the current generation of owners.

sections.heading: Farmland Ownership That Hasn't Changed Hands Much
paragraphs: If your family has farmed the same ground near St. Vincent for generations, your deed history is probably cleaner than what we see in areas with a lot of turnover, but it may still need updating if ownership has passed through a will that was never fully probated or a deed that named heirs without formally dividing shares.

sections.heading: How Pooling Affects a Farm Tract
paragraphs: If your property was pooled into a unit with neighboring farms, your royalty is calculated based on your proportionate share of the unit's total acreage, not only what happens directly under your own ground. That's standard practice, but it's worth confirming your pooling percentage is accurate against your actual acreage.

sections.heading: Getting a Straightforward Offer
paragraphs: We review your deed, confirm your unit participation and any lease terms, and put together a cash offer explained clearly. There's no obligation, and we're glad to walk through the numbers with you before you decide anything.

faqs.question: How do I know if my farm was pooled into a larger unit?
faqs.answer: Your division order or royalty statement should list the unit and your percentage share. We can also confirm this against DEP pooling orders on file.

faqs.question: My grandparents' will named several heirs but never formally divided the land. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: It's common and fixable. We help families clear up unresolved heirship situations as part of preparing to sell.

faqs.question: Does the college itself have any claim to nearby mineral rights?
faqs.answer: No. St. Vincent College's ownership is limited to its own campus property. Surrounding private farms retain their own separate mineral rights.
